description: This is a PHP source file implementing API endpoints for device configuration and token management, including functions for request processing, token generation and validation, and handling security features related to WiFi access points.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a cryptographic key stored in specific files, creating new ones if necessary.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Generates a secure token based on an encryption of the expiration timestamp.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a provided token by decrypting and checking its expiration timestamp.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests, primarily handling DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) information and updating WiFi access point settings.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Handles authentication by checking security headers or generating tokens, depending on security feature settings.
